title: Cannot run CEVAE model with GPU
author: xiaogangzhu

comments.author: fritzo
comments.body: Hmm, a quick workaround might be to `torch.set_default_device('cuda')`

comments.author: martinjankowiak
comments.body:

comments.author: xiaogangzhu
comments.body: Hi, I also use the dev branch but the model is cevae not cvae, the file is at /examples/contrib/cevae/synthetic.py

comments.author: martinjankowiak
comments.body:
@xiaogangzhu ok i can reproduce your issue and [this PR](https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3264) seems to fix it

this looks like a pytorch issue because the docstrings of `DataLoader` do not seem to suggest that passing a `generator` like this is required. might be worth checking with pytorch if this is a known issue and/or if it's been fixed in later versions

comments.author: xiaogangzhu
comments.body:
Hi, I saw the fixed in Dataloader function
```
 dataloader = DataLoader(
            dataset,
            batch_size=batch_size,
            shuffle=True,
            generator=torch.Generator(device=x.device),
        )
```
Thanks very much! But another problem is that when I am running the script I cannot set num_workers to improve my data loading speed just like what I usually do in pytorch. Is there any way to fix this?

comments.author: martinjankowiak
comments.body:
@xiaogangzhu this is meant to be an example pyro script not full service software with every conceivable functionality. if you want to add new features to support your use case you'll need to fork the script. 

thanks for reporting the GPU issue!
